en: Adam, Seth, enosh,
war: amo ini an sunodsunod nga mga ginikanan tikang kan adan: adan, set, enos,

en: kenan, mahalalel, jared,
war: kenan, mahalalel, hared,

en: Enoch, methuselah, lamech, Noah.
war: enoc, matusalem,

en: the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham and Japheth.
war: lamec, noe. hi noe mayada tulo nga mga anak: hira sem, Ham, ug jafet.

en: the sons of gomer: ashkenaz, riphath and togarmah.
war: an mga anak ni gomer amo hira ascenez, rifat, ug togorma.

en: the sons of javan: elishah, tarshish, the kittites and the rodanites.
war: an mga anak ni javan amo hira elisa, tarsis, ciprus, ug roda.

en: the sons of Ham: cush, Egypt, put and Canaan.
war: an mga anak ni Ham amo hira cus, Ehipto, Libya, ug Canaan, nga amo an mga ginikanan han katawhan nga nagdara han ira mga ngaran.

en: cush was the father of nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on earth.
war: hi cus amo an amay ni nimrod, an syahan nga gamhanan nga tawo han tuna.)

en: Egypt was the father of the ludites, anamites, lehabites, naphtuhites,
war: an mga tulin ni Ehipto amo an mga tawo ha lidia, anam, lehab, naftu,

en: pathrusites, kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and caphtorites.
war: patrus, caslu, ug creta (nga amo an ginikanan han mga filisteohanon).

en: Jebusites, Amorites, girgashites,
war: an mga tulin ni Canaan amo an mga jebuseohanon, amoreohanon, girgaseohanon,

en: Hivites, arkites, sinites,
war: hebeohanon, arkeohanon, sineohanon,

en: arvadites, zemarites and hamathites.
war: arbadeohanon, semareohanon, ug hamateohanon.

en: arphaxad was the father of shelah, and shelah the father of eber.
war: hi arfacsad amo an amay ni sela nga amay ni eber.

en: joktan was the father of almodad, sheleph, hazarmaveth, jerah,
war: hi joctan amo an amay ni almodad, selef, asarmot, jera,

en: hadoram, uzal, diklah,
war: adoram, usal, dicla,

en: obal, abimael, sheba,
war: hebal, abimael, saba,

en: ophir, havilah and jobab. all these were sons of joktan.
war: ofir, habila, ug jobab.

en: Shem, arphaxad, shelah,
war: tikang kan sem ngadto kan Abraham an sunodsunod nga mga ginikanan amo ini: sem, arfacsad, sela,

en: eber, peleg, reu,
war: eber, peleg, ragu,

en: serug, nahor, terah
war: serug, nacor, tera,

en: and abram (that is, Abraham).
war: ug abram (nga kinikilala liwat han ngaran nga Abraham).

en: the sons of Abraham: Isaac and ishmael.
war: mayada duha nga anak hi Abraham: hira Isaac ug ismael.

en: mishma, dumah, massa, hadad, tema,
war: misma, duma, masa, hadad, tema,

en: jetur, naphish and kedemah. these were the sons of ishmael.
war: jetor, nafis, ug kedema.

en: the sons of midian: ephah, epher, hanok, abida and eldaah. all these were descendants of keturah.
war: an mga anak ni midian amo hira efa, efer, hanoc, abida, ug eldea.

en: Abraham was the father of Isaac. the sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
war: amay hi Abraham ni Isaac. mayada duha nga anak hi Isaac: hira Esau ug Jacob.

en: the sons of Esau: eliphaz, reuel, jeush, jalam and korah.
war: an mga anak ni Esau amo hira elifas, reuel, jeus, halam, ug cora.

en: the sons of eliphaz: teman, omar, zepho, gatam and kenaz; by timna: amalek.
war: an mga anak ni elifas amo hira teman, omar, sefo, gatam, kenaz, timna, ug amalec.

en: the sons of reuel: nahath, zerah, shammah and mizzah.
war: an mga anak ni reuel amo hira nahat, sera, sama, ug masa.

en: the sons of seir: lotan, shobal, zibeon, anah, dishon, ezer and dishan.
war: an mga anak ni seir amo hira lotan, sobal, zibeon, ana, dison, eser, ug disan.

en: the sons of lotan: hori and homam. timna was lotans sister.
war: duha an mga anak ni lotan: hira hori ug homam. hi timna amo an bugto nga babaye ni lotan.

en: the son of anah: dishon. the sons of dishon: hemdan, eshban, ithran and keran.
war: mayada anak hi ana nga hi dison ngan an mga anak ni dison amo hira hamran, esban, itran, ug queran.

en: the sons of ezer: bilhan, zaavan and akan. the sons of dishan :: uz and aran.
war: an mga anak ni eser amo hira bilhan, saban, ug jacan. an duha nga mga anak ni disan amo hira hus ug aran.

en: hadad also died. the chiefs of Edom were: timna, alvah, jetheth,
war: an mga tawo ha edumea nagkabahin hinin masunod nga mga tribo: timna, alva,

en: oholibamah, elah, pinon,
war: oholibama, ela, pinon,

en: kenaz, teman, mibzar,
war: kenas, timan, mibsar,

en: magdiel and iram. these were the chiefs of Edom.
war: magdiel, ug iram.

en: these were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
war: inin masunod amo an mga anak ni Jacob: ruben, Simeon, Levi, Juda, isacar, zabulon,

en: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
war: Dan, Jose, Benjamin, neftali, Gad, ug aser.

en: judahs daughterinlaw tamar bore perez and zerah to Judah. he had five sons in all.
war: mayada pa hi Juda duha nga anak: hira peres ug sera ngan an ira iroy amo hi tamar nga umagad ni Juda.

en: the sons of perez: hezron and hamul.
war: hi peres mayada duha nga anak: hira hesron ug hamul.

en: the sons of zerah: zimri, ethan, heman, kalkol and darda —five in all.
war: hi sera nga iya bugto mayada lima nga mga anak: hira simri, etan, reman, calcal, ug darda.

en: the son of ethan: azariah.
war: hi etan mayada usa nga anak nga amo hi asarias.

en: the sons born to hezron were: jerahmeel, ram and Caleb.
war: hi hesron mayada tulo nga mga anak: hira jerameel, ram, ug Caleb.

en: nahshon was the father of salmon, salmon the father of Boaz,
war: salmon, boos,

en: Boaz the father of obed and obed the father of jesse.
war: obed, ug isai.

en: jesse was the father of eliab his firstborn; the second son was abinadab, the third shimea,
war: hi isai mayada pito nga mga anak. tikang han timagurangi amo inin pagkasunodsunod: eliab, abinadab, sama,

en: the fourth nethanel, the fifth raddai,
war: netanael, radai,

en: the sixth ozem and the seventh David.
war: asom, ug David.

en: abigail was the mother of amasa, whose father was jether the ishmaelite.
war: hi amasa amo an anak ni abigail ngan an amay ni amasa amo hi jeter, usa nga ismaelita.

en: when azubah died, Caleb married ephrath, who bore him hur.
war: han kamatay ni asuba, nangasawa hi Caleb kan efrata ug mayada hira usa nga anak nga amo hi hur.

en: hur was the father of uri, and uri the father of bezalel.
war: hi uri amo an anak ni hur ug hi besaleel amo an iya apo.

en: segub was the father of jair, who controlled twentythree towns in Gilead.
war: ngan ini hi segub mayada liwat anak nga hi jair. nagmangulo hi jair hin 23 nga mga syudad didto han tuna ni galaad.

en: the sons of onam: shammai and jada. the sons of shammai: nadab and abishur.
war: hi onam mayada duha nga anak: hira samai ug jada. hi samai mayada liwat duha nga anak: hira nadab ug abisur.

en: abishurs wife was named abihail, who bore him ahban and molid.
war: ginasawa ni abisur hi abigail ngan mayada nira duha nga anak: hira aban ug molid.

en: the sons of nadab: seled and appaim. seled died without children.
war: hi nadab nga bugto ni abisur mayada duha nga anak: hira saled ug afaim, kundi namatay hi saled nga waray mga anak.

en: the sons of jada, shammais brother: jether and Jonathan. jether died without children.
war: hi jada, an bugto ni samai, mayada duha nga anak: hira jeter ug jonatan, kundi namatay hi jeter nga waray mga anak.

en: the sons of Jonathan: peleth and zaza. these were the descendants of jerahmeel.
war: mayada duha nga anak hi jonatan: hira petel ug sisa. ini hira ngatanan mga tulin ni jerameel.

en: sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant jarha, and she bore him attai.
war: ngan iginpaasawa ini hiya han usa nga anak nga babaye niya. naganak ini hira kan atai.

en: the sons of Hebron: korah, tappuah, rekem and shema.
war: hi Hebron mayada upat nga anak: hira cora, tafua, rekem, ug sama.

en: shema was the father of raham, and raham the father of jorkeam. rekem was the father of shammai.
war: hi sama amo an amay ni raham ug apo ni jorkiam. hi rekem, nga bugto ni sama, amo an amay ni samai

en: the son of shammai was maon, and maon was the father of beth zur.
war: nga amay ni maon ngan ini hi maon amo an amay ni betsur.

en: the sons of jahdai: regem, jotham, geshan, pelet, ephah and shaaph.
war: mayada tawo nga an ngaran hi hadai ngan ini nga tawo mayada unom nga anak: hira regem, joatan, gesan, pelet, efa, ug saaf.)

en: calebs concubine maakah was the mother of sheber and tirhanah.
war: mayada liwat lain nga aruasawa hi Caleb, hi maaca, ngan mayada nira duha nga anak: hira saber ug terhana.

en: salma the father of Bethlehem, and hareph the father of beth gader.
war: kan salma nga amay ni betlehem ug kan haref nga amay ni betgader.

en: there were also ibhar, elishua, eliphelet,
war: mayada pa niya siyam nga mga anak: hira ibaar, elisua, elifelet,

en: nogah, nepheg, japhia,
war: noge, nefeg, japia,

en: elishama, eliada and elipheletnine in all.
war: elisama, eliada, ug elifelet.

en: all these were the sons of David, besides his sons by his concubines. and tamar was their sister.
war: labot hini, mayada pa niya mga anak nga iya ug han iya mga aruasawa. hi tamar la an iya anak nga babaye.

en: the sons of josiah: johanan the firstborn, jehoiakim the second son, zedekiah the third, shallum the fourth.
war: hi josias mayada upat nga anak: hira johanan, joakim, sedequias, ug joas.

en: the successors of jehoiakim: jehoiachin his son, and zedekiah.
war: hi joakim mayada duha nga anak: hira joaquin ug sedequias.

en: the descendants of jehoiachin the captive: shealtiel his son,
war: amo ini an mga tulin ni hadi joaquin nga ginhalin han mga tagababilonia. mayada pito nga anak hi joaquin: hira salatiel,

en: malkiram, pedaiah, shenazzar, jekamiah, hoshama and nedabiah.
war: melquiram, pedayas, senesar, jecamias, hosama, ug nabadias.

en: there were also five others: hashubah, ohel, berekiah, hasadiah and jushabhesed.
war: mayada pa hi sorobabel lima nga anak: hira hasaban, ohol, baraquias, hasadias, ug jusabesed.

en: the sons of neariah: elioenai, hizkiah and azrikamthree in all.
war: hi naaria mayada tulo nga anak: hira elioenai, ezequias, ug esricam.

en: the sons of elioenai: hodaviah, eliashib, pelaiah, akkub, johanan, delaiah and ananiseven in all.
war: mayada pito nga anak hi elioenai: hira hodavias, eliasib, pelaias, acub, johanan, delaias, ug anani.

en: the descendants of Judah: perez, hezron, karmi, hur and shobal.
war: inin masunod amo an mga anak ni Juda: hira fares, jezron, carmi, hur, ug sobal.

en: ashhur the father of tekoa had two wives, helah and naarah.
war: hi asur nga amay ni tecoa mayada duha nga asawa: hira halaa ug naara.

en: naarah bore him ahuzzam, hepher, temeni and haahashtari. these were the descendants of naarah.
war: hi asur ngan hi naara mayada upat nga anak: hira ausan, hefer, temani, ug ahastari.

en: the sons of helah: zereth, zohar, ethnan,
war: hi asur ngan hi halaa mayada tulo nga anak: hira seret, isaar, ug etnan.

en: and koz, who was the father of anub and hazzobebah and of the clans of aharhel son of harum.
war: hi cos amo an amay ni anob ug soboba ngan an ginikanan han mga banay ni aharehel, an anak ni arum.

en: kelub, shuhahs brother, was the father of mehir, who was the father of eshton.
war: hi Caleb, an bugto ni sua, mayada anak, hi mehir. hi mehir amo an amay ni eston.

en: eshton was the father of beth rapha, paseah and tehinnah the father of ir nahash. these were the men of rekah.
war: hi eston mayada tulo nga anak: hira betrafa, fese, ug hi tehina nga amay ni naas. mga ginikanan hira hadton mga nagukoy ha reca.

en: the sons of kenaz: othniel and seraiah. the sons of othniel: hathath and meonothai.
war: hi kenes mayada duha nga anak: hira otoniel ug saraya; hi otoniel mayada duha nga anak: hira hatat ug maonati.

en: the sons of Caleb son of jephunneh: iru, elah and naam. the son of elah: kenaz.
war: hi Caleb nga anak ni jefone mayada tulo nga anak: hira hir, ela, ug naam. hi ela amo an amay ni kenes.

en: the sons of jehallelel: ziph, ziphah, tiria and asarel.
war: hi jaleleel mayada upat nga anak: hira sif, sifa, tiria, ug asareel.

en: they were the potters who lived at netaim and gederah; they stayed there and worked for the king.
war: mga parahimo hira hin daba para han hadi ngan nagukoy hira didto han mga bungto han netaim ug gedera.

en: the descendants of Simeon: nemuel, jamin, jarib, zerah and shaul;
war: amo ini an mga tulin ni Simeon: hira nemuel, jamin, jarib, zara, ug Saul.

en: shallum was shauls son, mibsam his son and mishma his son.
war: hi selum amo an anak ni Saul; hi salum amay ni mabsam nga amay ni masma.

en: the descendants of mishma: hammuel his son, zakkur his son and shimei his son.
war: hi masma mayada mga anak: hira hamuel, sacur, ug simei.

en: they lived in Beersheba, moladah, hazar shual,
war: tubtob han panahon ni hadi David, didto pagukoy an mga tulin ni Simeon hinin masunod nga mga bungto: berseba, molada, hazarsual,

en: bilhah, ezem, tolad,
war: bala, asom, tolad,

en: bethuel, hormah, ziklag,
war: batuel, horma, siklag,

en: beth markaboth, hazar susim, beth biri and shaaraim. these were their towns until the reign of David.
war: betmarkabot, hazarsusim, betberei, ug saarim.

en: their surrounding villages were etam, ain, rimmon, token and ashanfive towns—
war: nagukoy liwat hira didto hin lain nga lima nga mga dapit: ha etam, ain, remon, toquen, ug asan,

en: they killed the remaining Amalekites who had escaped, and they have lived there to this day.
war: pinamatay nira didto an mga tulin ni amalec ngan didto na hira pagukoy ngada yana.

en: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: hanok, pallu, hezron and karmi.
war: hi ruben, an timagurangi han mga anak ni Jacob, mayada upat nga anak: hira hanoc, falu, hesron, ug carmi.

en: ahi son of abdiel, the son of guni, was head of their family.
war: hi ahi, nga anak ni abdiel ngan apo ni guni amo an pangulo hini nga mga banay.

en: they waged war against the hagrites, jetur, naphish and nodab.
war: nakigaway hira kontra han mga tribo ni agar, itor, napis, ug nodab.

en: the sons of Levi: gershon, kohath and merari.
war: hi Levi mayada tulo nga anak: hira gerson, cohat, ug merari.

en: the sons of kohath: amram, izhar, Hebron and uzziel.
war: hi cohat mayada upat nga anak: hira amram, isar, Hebron, ug usiel.

en: eleazar was the father of phinehas, phinehas the father of abishua,
war: an mga tulin ni eleazar amo inin masunod: pinehas, abisue,

en: abishua the father of bukki, bukki the father of uzzi,
war: boci, uzi,

en: uzzi the father of zerahiah, zerahiah the father of meraioth,
war: saraias, merayot,

en: meraioth the father of amariah, amariah the father of ahitub,
war: amarias, aguitob,

en: ahitub the father of zadok, zadok the father of ahimaaz,
war: sadoc, aquimas,

en: ahimaaz the father of azariah, azariah the father of johanan,
war: asarias, ug johanan.

en: johanan the father of azariah (it was he who served as priest in the temple Solomon built in Jerusalem),
war: hi johanan mayada liwat anak nga hi asarias (nga nagalagad didto han templo nga gintindog ni hadi Solomon didto ha Jerusalem).

en: azariah the father of amariah, amariah the father of ahitub,
war: hi asarias mayada liwat anak nga hi amarias nga amay ni aquitob nga amay ni sadoc.

en: ahitub the father of zadok, zadok the father of shallum,
war: hi sadoc amay liwat ni selum nga amay ni

en: shallum the father of hilkiah, hilkiah the father of azariah,
war: helkias nga amay ni asarias.

en: azariah the father of seraiah, and seraiah the father of jozadak.
war: hi asarias amay ni saraias nga amay ni josedec.

en: jozadak was deported when the Lord sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of nebuchadnezzar.
war: ginhalin hi josedec ni hadi nabucodonosor upod han mga tawo han Juda ug Jerusalem nga iginpabihag han Ginoo ..

en: the sons of Levi: gershon, kohath and merari.
war: mayada hi Levi tulo nga anak: hira gerson, cohat, ug merari.

en: these are the names of the sons of gershon: libni and shimei.
war: kada usa ha ira mayada mga anak. mayada duha nga anak hi gerson: hira libni ug simei.

en: the sons of kohath: amram, izhar, Hebron and uzziel.
war: hi cohat mayada upat nga anak: hira amram, isar, Hebron, ug usiel.

en: of gershon: libni his son, jahath his son, zimmah his son,
war: amo ini an mga tulin ni gerson: hira libni, jahat, zama, ado,

en: joah his son, iddo his son, zerah his son and jeatherai his son.
war: joa, sera, ug jetrai.

en: the descendants of kohath: amminadab his son, korah his son, assir his son,
war: amo ini an mga tulin ni cohat: hira aminadab, core, asir, abiasaf,

en: elkanah his son, ebiasaph his son, assir his son,
war: elcana, lain nga asir nga anak ni elcana,

en: tahath his son, uriel his son, uzziah his son and shaul his son.
war: tahat, uriel, uzias, ug Saul.

en: the descendants of elkanah: amasai, ahimoth,
war: hi elcana mayada duha nga anak: hira amasai ug aquimot.

en: elkanah his son, zophai his son, nahath his son,
war: amo ini an mga tulin ni aquimot: hira elcana, anak ini ni aquimot, sofai, nahat,

en: eliab his son, jeroham his son, elkanah his son and Samuel his son.
war: elab, Jeroboam, ngan hin lain nga elcana nga anak liwat ni Jeroboam.

en: the sons of Samuel: Joel the firstborn and abijah the second son.
war: hi Samuel mayada duha nga anak: hira Joel, an magurang ug abias, an manghod.

en: the descendants of merari: mahli, libni his son, shimei his son, uzzah his son,
war: amo ini an mga tulin ni merari: hira moholi, libni, simei, uza,

en: shimea his son, haggiah his son and asaiah his son.
war: samaa, hagia, ug asaya.

en: the son of elkanah, the son of jeroham, the son of eliel, the son of toah,
war: elcana, jeroham, eliel, tohu,

en: the son of zuph, the son of elkanah, the son of mahath, the son of amasai,
war: sug, elcana, mahat, amasai,

en: the son of elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
war: elcana, Joel, azarias, sofonias,

en: the son of tahath, the son of assir, the son of ebiasaph, the son of korah,
war: tahat, asir, ebiasaf, core,

en: the son of izhar, the son of kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel;
war: isar, cohat, Levi, Jacob.

en: the son of michael, the son of baaseiah, the son of malkijah,
war: micael, basaya, melquia,

en: the son of ethni, the son of zerah, the son of adaiah,
war: atanai, zara, adaya,

en: the son of ethan, the son of zimmah, the son of shimei,
war: etan, sama, simei,

en: the son of jahath, the son of gershon, the son of Levi;
war: jet, gerson, ug Levi.

en: the son of hashabiah, the son of amaziah, the son of hilkiah,
war: asabias, amasias, helkias,

en: the son of amzi, the son of bani, the son of shemer,
war: amasai, boni, somer,

en: the son of mahli, the son of mushi, the son of merari, the son of Levi.
war: moholi, musi, merari, Levi.

en: their fellow Levites were assigned to all the other duties of the tabernacle, the house of God.
war: an ira igkasi mga Levita tinagan hin iba nga mga buruhaton didto han siringbahan nira nga dapit.

en: bukki his son, uzzi his son, zerahiah his son,
war: boci, uzi, saraias,

en: meraioth his son, amariah his son, ahitub his son,
war: merayot, amarias, aquitob,

en: zadok his son and ahimaaz his son.
war: sadoc, ug aquimas.

en: they were given Hebron in Judah with its surrounding pasturelands.
war: nasasakop hini an Hebron didto ha tuna han Juda ngan han naglilibot nga panabsaban nga tuna.

en: but the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of jephunneh.
war: an mga kaumhan ug mga baryo nga kanan syudad iginahin para kan Caleb, an anak ni jefone.

en: some of the kohathite clans were given as their territory towns from the tribe of ephraim.
war: mayada mga panimalay han banay ni cohat nga ginahinan han mga bungto ug panabsaban didto han katunaan ni efraim.

en: jokmeam, beth horon,
war: jecmaan, betoron,

en: aijalon and Gath rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
war: helon, ug gatrimon.

en: ramoth and anem, together with their pasturelands;
war: 7273 didto han katunaan ni isacar: an cades, daberet, ramot, ug anem.

en: hukok and rehob, together with their pasturelands;
war: 7475 didto han katunaan ni aser: an masal, abdon, hucac, ug rahob.

en: heshbon and jazer, together with their pasturelands.
war: 8081 didto han katunaan ni Gad: an ramot ha galaad, manaim, hesbon, ug jeser.

en: the sons of Issachar: tola, puah, jashub and shimronfour in all.
war: mayada upat nga anak hi isacar: hira tola, jasub, pua, ug simron.

en: three sons of Benjamin: bela, beker and jediael.
war: hi Benjamin mayada tulo nga anak: hira bela, becor, ug jadiel.

en: the shuppites and huppites were the descendants of ir, and the hushites the descendants of aher.
war: upod dida hini nga tribo hira sefam ug hafam nga mga anak ni hir. usa la an anak ni Dan: hi hasim.

en: the sons of Naphtali: jahziel, guni, jezer and shillem —the descendants of bilhah.
war: mayada upat nga anak hi neftali: hira jasiel, guni, jeser, ug selum. (mga tulin ini hira ni bilha.)

en: the son of ulam: bedan. these were the sons of Gilead son of makir, the son of manasseh.
war: hi ulam mayada anak, hi dedan. amo ini an mga tulin ni galaad, nga anak ni maquir ug apo ni manases.

en: his sister hammoleketh gave birth to ishhod, abiezer and mahlah.
war: hi hamolequet, nga bugto nga babaye ni galaad, amo an iroy nira isod, abieser, ug mohola. ((

en: the sons of shemida were: ahian, Shechem, likhi and aniam.
war: an mga anak ni semida amo hira ahin, siquem, leci, ug aniam.)

en: their father ephraim mourned for them many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
war: nagmasulobon an ira amay, hi efraim, hin maiha nga mga adlaw ngan kinmadto ha iya an iya mga kabugtoan hin pagliaw ha iya.

en: rephah was his son, resheph his son, telah his son, tahan his son,
war: mayada liwat anak hi efraim nga lalake, hi rafa, kanay mga tulin amo inin masunod: resef, tale,

en: ladan his son, ammihud his son, elishama his son,
war: taan, laadan, amiud, ug elisama nga amay ni nun.

en: nun his son and Joshua his son.
war: hi nun amo an amay ni josue.

en: the sons of Asher: imnah, ishvah, ishvi and beriah. their sister was serah.
war: inin masunod amo an mga anak ni aser: hira jemha, jesua, jesui, ug beria, ug usa nga anak nga babaye, hi sara.

en: the sons of beriah: heber and malkiel, who was the father of birzaith.
war: hi beria mayada duha nga anak: hira heber ug melquiel nga amay ni barsahit.

en: heber was the father of japhlet, shomer and hotham and of their sister shua.
war: mayada tulo nga mga anak hi heber: hira heplat, somer, ug jotam, ngan hi sua amo an iya anak nga babaye.

en: the sons of japhlet: pasak, bimhal and ashvath. these were japhlets sons.
war: hi heplat mayada tulo liwat nga anak: hira fosec, bemhal, ug asbat.

en: the sons of shomer: ahi, rohgah, hubbah and aram.
war: hi somer nga bugto ni jeplat mayada tulo nga anak: hira roaga, haba, ug aram.

en: the sons of his brother helem: zophah, imna, shelesh and amal.
war: hi jotam nga bugto ni heplat, mayada upat nga anak: hira sofa, jemna, celes, ug amal.

en: the sons of zophah: suah, harnepher, shual, beri, imrah,
war: an mga tulin ni sofa amo hira sue, harnaper, sual, beri, hamra,

en: bezer, hod, shamma, shilshah, ithran and beera.
war: bosor, hod, sama, salusa, jetran, ug bera.

en: the sons of jether: jephunneh, pispah and ara.
war: an mga tulin ni jeter amo hira jefone, fasfa, ug ara.

en: the sons of ulla: arah, hanniel and rizia.
war: hi hola mayada liwat tulo nga anak: hira arae, haniel, ug resia.

en: Benjamin was the father of bela his firstborn, ashbel the second son, aharah the third,
war: hi Benjamin mayada lima nga anak. tikang ha timagurangi, amo ini hira bela, asbel, ahara,

en: nohah the fourth and rapha the fifth.
war: nohaa, ug rafa, nga amo an timanghuri.

en: the sons of bela were: addar, gera, abihud,
war: hi bela mayada mga anak: hira adar, gera, abiud,

en: abishua, naaman, ahoah,
war: abisue, naaman, ahoe,

en: gera, shephuphan and huram.
war: gera, sefufan, ug huram.

en: jeuz, sakia and mirmah. these were his sons, heads of families.
war: jeus, sequia, ug marma.

en: by hushim he had abitub and elpaal.
war: mayada liwat niya anak kan husim: hira abitud ug elfaal.

en: ahio, shashak, jeremoth,
war: an mga tulin ni beria amo hira ahio, sesac, jerimot,

en: zebadiah, arad, eder,
war: sabadia, arad, eder,

en: michael, ishpah and joha were the sons of beriah.
war: micael, jezfa, ug joha.

en: zebadiah, meshullam, hizki, heber,
war: an mga tulin ni elfaal amo hira sabadia, mesolam, hezec, heber,

en: ishmerai, izliah and jobab were the sons of elpaal.
war: jesamari, jeslie, ug jobad.

en: jakim, zikri, zabdi,
war: an mga tulin ni simei amo hira jacim, secri, zabdi,

en: elienai, zillethai, eliel,
war: elioenai, seletai, eliel,

en: adaiah, beraiah and shimrath were the sons of shimei.
war: adaya, baraya, ug samarat.

en: ishpan, eber, eliel,
war: an mga tulin ni sesac amo hira jesfam, heber, eliel,

en: abdon, zikri, hanan,
war: abdon, secri, hanan,

en: hananiah, Elam, anthothijah,
war: hananias, Elam, anatotia,

en: iphdeiah and penuel were the sons of shashak.
war: jefdaya, ug fanuel.

en: shamsherai, shehariah, athaliah,
war: an mga tulin ni jeroham amo hira samsari, sohoria, otolia,

en: jaareshiah, Elijah and zikri were the sons of jeroham.
war: jersia, elia, ug secri.

en: and mikloth, who was the father of shimeah. they too lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.
war: macelot, an amay ni samaa. ini hira didto magukoy atbang han iba nga mga panimalay han ira banay.

en: the son of Jonathan: meribbaal, who was the father of Micah.
war: hi jonatan mayada anak, hi meribaal nga amay ni mica.

en: the sons of Micah: pithon, melek, tarea and ahaz.
war: hi mica mayada mga anak: hira fiton, melec, taraa, ug ahas.

en: moza was the father of binea; raphah was his son, eleasah his son and azel his son.
war: hi mosa amo an amay ni binea nga amay ni rafa nga amay ni elasa nga amay ni asel.

en: those from Judah, from Benjamin, and from ephraim and manasseh who lived in Jerusalem were:
war: an mga tawo han mga tribo ni Juda, Benjamin, efraim, ug manases inmoli ngadto ha Jerusalem ug didto hira nagukoy.

en: the gatekeepers: shallum, akkub, talmon, ahiman and their fellow Levites, shallum their chief
war: inin masunod nga mga magbarantay han templo nagukoy ha Jerusalem: hira selum, acub, telmon, ug ahinam. hi selum an ira pangulo.

en: in earlier times phinehas son of eleazar was the official in charge of the gatekeepers, and the Lord was with him.
war: hi pinehas nga anak ni eleasar amo hadto anay an nagdumara ha ira ug an Ginoo dayuday kaupod niya.

en: Zechariah son of meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
war: hi zacarias nga anak ni mosolamia amo liwat an bantay han portahan han tulda han Ginoo ..

en: the gatekeepers were on the four sides: east, west, north and south.
war: mayada mga aragian ha sinirangan, katundan, amihanan, ug timogan nga dapit ug an tagsa hini mayada pangulo nga magbarantay.

en: but some of the priests took care of mixing the spices.
war: kundi an katungdanan han mga pagsakot han mga pahamot kanan mga kapadian ini.

war: hi jahiel amo an nagtindog han syudad han gabaon ngan didto hiya pagukoy. hi maaca an iya asawa.

en: and his firstborn son was abdon, followed by zur, kish, baal, ner, nadab,

war: hi jonatan mayada anak, hi meribaal nga amay ni mica.

en: the sons of Micah: pithon, melek, tahrea and ahaz.
war: mayada upat nga anak hi mica: hira fiton, melec, taraa, ug ahas.

en: ahaz was the father of jadah, jadah was the father of alemeth, azmaveth and zimri, and zimri was the father of moza.
war: hi ahas amo an amay ni jara nga amay nira alamat, asmot, ug samri nga amay ni mosa.

en: moza was the father of binea; rephaiah was his son, eleasah his son and azel his son.
war: hi mosa amo an amay ni banas nga amay ni rafaya nga amay ni elasa nga amay ni asel.

en: the fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him.
war: naalikosan hi Saul han iya mga kaaway ngan naigo hiya hin mga pana ngan grabe an iya mga samad.

en: when all the inhabitants of jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
war: han paghibaro han mga tawo han jabes didto ha galaad han ginbuhat han mga filisteohanon kan Saul,

en: and did not inquire of the Lord .. so the Lord put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of jesse.
war: sanglit ginpatay hiya han Ginoo ngan iginhatag an pagdumara han ginhadian ngadto kan David nga anak ni isai.

en: David then took up residence in the fortress, and so it was called the city of David.
war: tungod kay didto man hi David pagukoy ha balwarte, ginngaranan ini nga “syudad ni David.”

en: and David became more and more powerful, because the Lord Almighty was with him.
war: nagtikakusog hi David tungod kay kaupod niya an dyos nga labi kamakagarahum.

en: next to him was eleazar son of dodai the ahohite, one of the three mighty warriors.
war: an sunod dida han bantogan nga “tutulo” amo hi eleazar, anak ni dodo nga sakop han banay ni aho.

en: such were the exploits of benaiah son of jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty warriors.
war: amo ini an maisog nga mga binuhatan ni benaias, an usa han hugpo han “traynta.”

en: other benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
war: mayada usa ka hugpo hin mga tawo tikang han mga tribo nira Benjamin ug Juda nga kinmadto han balwarte nga inuokyan ni David.

en: David conferred with each of his officers, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.
war: nakighimangraw hi David han mga opisyal nga nagmamando hin tinagyukot ug tinaggatos nga mga sondalo.

en: let us bring the ark of our God back to us, for we did not inquire of it during the reign of Saul.”
war: ngan maguorusa kita hin paglakat basi makuha naton an kahon han ginsaaran nga waray pagdiparaa ni Saul han hadi pa hiya.”

en: the whole assembly agreed to do this, because it seemed right to all the people.
war: inmuyon an mga tawo ngan nagkasarabot hira.

en: these are the names of the children born to him there: shammua, shobab, nathan, Solomon,
war: amo ini an iya mga anak nga natawo didto ha Jerusalem: hira samua, sobab, natan, Solomon,

en: ibhar, elishua, elpelet,
war: ibaar, elisua, elifelet,

en: nogah, nepheg, japhia,
war: noga, nefeg, jafia,

en: elishama, beeliada and eliphelet.
war: elisama, baayada, ug usa pa nga elifelet.

en: now the Philistines had come and raided the valley of rephaim;
war: nagkaabot hin pagsulong han kahamuban han refaim an mga filisteohanon.

en: the Philistines had abandoned their gods there, and David gave orders to burn them in the fire.
war: han pangalagiw han mga filisteohanon, ginbayaan nira didto an ira mga diyosdiyos ngan ginpasunog ini ni David.

en: once more the Philistines raided the valley;
war: niyan binmalik an mga filisteohanon ngadto han kahamuban ngan ira na liwat ginsulong.

en: so davids fame spread throughout every land, and the Lord made all the nations fear him.
war: nabantogan hi David bisan diin nga dapit ngan nahadlok ha iya an mga nasod.

en: he called together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites:
war: kasunod, ginpasugoan niya an mga tulin ni Aaron ug an mga Levita.

en: from the descendants of kohath, uriel the leader and 120 relatives;
war: tikang han Levita nga banay ni cohat, inmabot hi uriel nga tinaporan hin 120 nga sakop han iya banay;

en: from the descendants of merari, asaiah the leader and 220 relatives;
war: tikang han banay ni merari, inmabot hi asaya nga tinaporan hin 220 nga sakop han iya banay;

en: from the descendants of gershon, Joel the leader and 130 relatives;
war: tikang han banay ni gerson, inmabot hi Joel nga tinaporan hin 130 nga sakop han iya banay;

en: from the descendants of elizaphan, shemaiah the leader and 200 relatives;
war: tikang han banay ni elisafan, inmabot hi semeias nga tinaporan hin 200 nga sakop han iya banay;

en: from the descendants of Hebron, eliel the leader and 80 relatives;
war: tikang han banay ni Hebron, inmabot hi eliel nga tinaporan hin 80 nga sakop han iya banay;

en: from the descendants of uzziel, amminadab the leader and 112 relatives.
war: ug tikang han banay ni oziel, inmabot hi abinadab nga tinaporan hin 112 nga sakop han iya banay.

en: kenaniah the head levite was in charge of the singing; that was his responsibility because he was skillful at it.
war: tungod kay batid hin musika hi conenias ginpili hiya nira nga tinaporan han mga parakanta nga mga Levita;

en: give praise to the Lord ,, proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.
war: pagpasalamat ngadto han Ginoo ,, igsangyaw an iya kagamhanan, sumati an mga nasod han iya ginbuhat.

en: sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.
war: pagdaywa an Ginoo ;; igsumat an mga makaaramdok nga butang nga iya ginbuhat.

en: glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
war: paglipay tungod nga sakop kita niya, maglipay an ngatanan nga nagsisingba ha iya!

en: look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.
war: pakadto ha Ginoo hin pakibulig, dayuday singbaha hiya.

en: he is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
war: an Ginoo amo an aton dyos; an iya mga sugo para han ngatanan.

en: he remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made, for a thousand generations,
war: ayaw hingalimti an ginsaaran han Ginoo nga ginhimo niya nga magpadayon,

en: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.
war: an ginsabotan nga ginhimo niya kan Abraham, an iya iginsaad ha kan Isaac.

en: he confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
war: naghimo an Ginoo hin ginsaaran kan Jacob, nga magpapadayon tubtob ha kataposan.

en: “to you i will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit.”
war: “ihahatag ko ha imo an tuna han Canaan”, nasiring hiya, “magigin iyo ini malon.”

en: when they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,
war: diri anay damo an mga tawo han dyos, mga lumalangyaw didto ha tuna han Canaan.

en: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
war: nagsudoysudoy hira ha mga katunaan, ha ngatanan nga mga kanasoran.

en: he allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:
war: kundi waray itugot han Ginoo nga pagraogdaogon hira, hin pagpanalipod ha ira, nagpahimatngon hiya han mga hadi,

en: “do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm.”
war: “ayaw paglabti an akon pinili nga mga surugoon; sugad man an akon mga manaragna.”

en: sing to the Lord ,, all the earth; proclaim his salvation day after day.
war: pagawit ngadto han Ginoo ,, an bugos nga kalibutan! ipasangyaw kada adlaw an maupay nga sumat nga gintalwas kita niya.

en: declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.
war: ipasangyaw an iya himaya ngadto han kanasoran, an iya pagkamakagarahum ngadto han mga tawo.

en: for great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.
war: gamhanan an Ginoo ngan angay hiya pagdayawon, angay hiya pagpasidunggan labaw han iba nga kadiyosan.

en: for all the gods of the nations are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.
war: an kadiyosan han iba nga kanasoran mga hinimo la nga dyos, kundi an Ginoo amo an naghimo han kalangitan.

en: splendor and majesty are before him; strength and joy are in his dwelling place.
war: lukop hiya han himaya ug kaharangdon, an gahom ug kalipay nakakaluob han templo.

en: ascribe to the Lord ,, all you families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
war: dayawa an Ginoo ,, mga tawo ha tuna, dayawa an iya gahom ug himaya.

en: tremble before him, all the earth! the world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
war: pangurog hin kahadlok ha iya atubangan, kamo nga aanhi ha tuna! madigon an katindog han tuna ngan diri gud ini mawawaring.

en: let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let them say among the nations, “the Lord reigns!”
war: paglipay, tuna ug langit! sumati an mga nasod nga hadi an Ginoo ..

en: let the sea resound, and all that is in it; let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them!
war: rayhak, dagat, ug an mga binuhat dida ha imo, paglipay, mga kaumhan ug an mga tanom dida ha imo!

en: let the trees of the forest sing, let them sing for joy before the Lord ,, for he comes to judge the earth.
war: an mga kahoy ha kagurangan magoliat hin kalipay, kon makanhi an Ginoo hin paghadi han tuna.

en: give thanks to the Lord ,, for he is good; his love endures forever.
war: pagpasalamat han Ginoo ,, kay maupay hiya; an iya gugma waray kataposan.

en: nathan replied to David, “whatever you have in mind, do it, for God is with you.”
war: nagsiring hi natan, “buhata an imo ginhuhunahunaan, kay aada ha imo an Ginoo .”.”

en: but that night the word of God came to nathan, saying:
war: kundi hito nga gabi, an dyos nagsiring kan natan,

en: he is the one who will build a house for me, and i will establish his throne forever.
war: hiya amo an magtitindog hin templo para ha akon ngan tatalingohaon ko nga maghadi an iya katulinan ha kadayonan.

en: nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.
war: iginsumat ni natan kan David an ngatanan nga iginpadayag ha iya han dyos.

en: “what more can David say to you for honoring your servant? for you know your servant,
war: ano pa in akon igsisiring ha imo! nakilala ka ha akon kundi ginpapasidunggan mo ako, an imo surugoon.

en: “there is no one like you, Lord ,, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.
war: Ginoo ,, waray gud masugad ha imo; dayuday maaram kami nga ikaw la an dyos.

en: you, Lord ,, are God! you have promised these good things to your servant.
war: Ginoo ,, ikaw an dyos ngan imo ini ginhimo ha akon ini nga makaaramdok nga saad.

en: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to him and brought him tribute.
war: ginpirde liwat niya an mga moabitanhon nga nasakop niya ngan nagbayad ini hira ha iya hin mga buhis.

en: David took the gold shields carried by the officers of hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
war: ginagaw ni David an bulawan nga mga taming nga dara han mga opisyal ni hadadeser ngadto ha Jerusalem.

en: when tou king of hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of hadadezer king of zobah,
war: hinbatian ni hadi toi han hamat nga ginpirde ni David an ngatanan nga kasondalohan ni hadadeser.

en: abishai son of zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the valley of salt.
war: hi abisai, an anak ni seruia, nakapirde han mga edomitanhon didto han kahamuban asin ngan pinamatay niya in 18000 nga mga tawo.

en: joab son of zeruiah was over the army; jehoshaphat son of ahilud was recorder;
war: hi joab, nga bugto ni abisai amo an pangulo han kasondalohan; hi josafat nga anak ni ahilud amo an tinaporan han mga sinurat;

en: zadok son of ahitub and ahimelek son of abiathar were priests; shavsha was secretary;
war: hira sadoc nga anak ni ahitob ngan hi ahimelec, nga anak ni abiatar, amo an kapadian; hi saraias amo an sekretaryo han korte;

en: in the course of time, nahash king of the Ammonites died, and his son succeeded him as king.
war: waray kaiha namatay hi hadi nahas han amon ngan hi hanun, an iya anak, an naghadi.

en: on hearing this, David sent joab out with the entire army of fighting men.
war: han pakabati ni David han nahinanabo, ginpasugoan niya hi joab ug an ngatanan niya nga kasondalohan.

en: when he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of shimea, davids brother, killed him.
war: ginayat niya an mga israelita ngan ginpatay hiya ni jonatan, an anak ni simias nga bugto ni David.

en: these were descendants of rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.
war: ini nga tulo nga ginpatay ni David ug han iya mga tawo mga tulin ini hira han mga higante ha gat.

en: satan rose up against Israel and incited David to take a census of Israel.
war: karuyag magsamok hi satanas han mga tawo han Israel ug ginaghat niya hi David hin pagpaihap han mga tawo.

en: but joab did not include Levi and Benjamin in the numbering, because the kings command was repulsive to him.
war: tungod kay waray man umabuyon hi joab han sugo han hadi, waray niya pagihapa an mga tribo nira Levi ug Benjamin.

en: this command was also evil in the sight of God; so he punished Israel.
war: nabido an dyos tungod han ginbuhat, sanglit ginkastigo niya an mga israelita.

en: the Lord said to Gad, davids seer,
war: nagsiring an Ginoo kan Gad, an manaragna ni David,

en: so the Lord sent a plague on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.
war: sanglit nagpadara an Ginoo hin peste ha bugos nga Israel ngan 70000 nga mga tawo an namatay.

en: so David went up in obedience to the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the Lord ..
war: sinmugot hi David han sugo han Ginoo ngan kinmadto hiya sumala han ginsiring ha iya ni Gad.

en: so David paid araunah six hundred shekels of gold for the site.
war: ginbaydan niya hi arauna hin 6000 nga bulawan para han iya giriokan.

en: then the Lord spoke to the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.
war: ginsiring han Ginoo an anghel nga diri na gamiton niya an espada. sinmugot an anghel.

en: but David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the Lord ..
war: kundi hi David waray makahimo hin pagkadto hin pagsingba han dyos kay nahadlok hiya han espada han anghel han Ginoo ..

en: in gold and silver, bronze and ironcraftsmen beyond number. now begin the work, and the Lord be with you.”
war: hin bulawan, salapi, bronse, ug puthaw. yana tikangi an trabaho ngan an Ginoo maada unta ha imo!”

en: then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon.

war: mga baga nga naglalahinggab, hin kalayo naulyab.

en: who knows if the human spirit rises upward and if the spirit of the animal goes down into the earth?”
war: uunanhon hin paghibaroi han tawo nga natipaigbaw an espiritu hin tawo ngan natipatuna an espiritu hin mananap?

en: and i declared that the dead, who had already died, are happier than the living, who are still alive.
war: naawa ako hadton mga nagkamatay ngan binmaya na; mauruupay pa hira hadton mga buhi pa.

en: fools fold their hands and ruin themselves.
war: nasiring hira nga lurong in tawo nga nakugos han iya mga kamot ngan mamatay hin gutom.

en: again i saw something meaningless under the sun:
war: hinsabotan ko pa ha kinabuhi in lain liwat nga waray kapulsanan.

en: two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor:
war: an duduha mauruupay han uusa la, kay makakagtrabaho hin maupay hira nga duha.

en: also, if two lie down together, they will keep warm. but how can one keep warm alone?
war: kon mahagkot an panahon, nakakagdirig an duduha ngan papasoan hira, kundi uunanhon mo pagpapaso kon uusa ka la?

en: it is better not to make a vow than to make one and not fulfill it.
war: gabay ka pa diri magsaad, kay hin magsaad ka ngan diri nimo tumanon.

en: the increase from the land is taken by all; the king himself profits from the fields.
war: bisan ngani hadi nasarig han aranihon.

en: all their days they eat in darkness, with great frustration, affliction and anger.
war: naguokoy kita hin kinabuhi ha kasisidman ug kabidoan, dida hin kabaraka, kasina, ngan kasakit.

en: i have seen another evil under the sun, and it weighs heavily on mankind:
war: hinkitan ko in karatan nga ginbubuhat dinhe ha kalibutan.

en: it comes without meaning, it departs in darkness, and in darkness its name is shrouded.
war: waray kapulsanan an iya katawo, kay maanaw la hiya ngadto ha kasisidman, ngan hinngangalimtan.

en: though it never saw the sun or knew anything, it has more rest than does that man—
war: diri gud hiya makita han kapawa han adlaw, o masasayod kon ano an kinabuhi, kundi nakapahuway gihapon hiya.

en: everyones toil is for their mouth, yet their appetite is never satisfied.
war: nagbubuhat in tawo han ngatanan niya nga mga buruhaton basi la makakaon hiya, kundi diri gud hiya nasasadngan.

en: the more the words, the less the meaning, and how does that profit anyone?
war: kon mauruiha an imo pakiglantugi, labi na nga waray kapulsanan ini, ngan waray nimo makukuha.

en: frustration is better than laughter, because a sad face is good for the heart.
war: mauruupay pa han pagtawa an kabido, bangin makakabido ini han imo nawong, kundi nakakabaid ini han imo sarabotan.

en: the heart of the wise is in the house of mourning, but the heart of fools is in the house of pleasure.
war: lurong in tawo nga dayuday la naghuhunahuna hin kalipayan. naghuhunahuna hin kamatayon in tawo nga may kinaadman.

en: it is better to heed the rebuke of a wise person than to listen to the song of fools.
war: mauruupay pa nga sawayon ka han mga may kinaadman, kay pagkantahan ka hin mga pagdayaw han mga lurong.

en: like the crackling of thorns under the pot, so is the laughter of fools. this too is meaningless.
war: sugad la ini hin mga tunok nga nagbibiribti ha kalayo kon natawa in lurong; waray la ini kahulogan.

en: extortion turns a wise person into a fool, and a bribe corrupts the heart.
war: kon naglilimbong in tawo nga may kinaadman sugad hiya hin lurong. kon nakarawat ka hin hukip, gindadaot mo an imo pagkatawo.

en: do not be quickly provoked in your spirit, for anger resides in the lap of fools.
war: pugngi an imo kapungot; tinuyaw an pagtipig hin pagdumot.

en: wisdom, like an inheritance, is a good thing and benefits those who see the sun.
war: an ngatanan nga buhi kinahanglan nga mayada kinaadman; sugad ini kamaupay hin pagkarawat hin panurondon,

en: do not be overwicked, and do not be a fool— why die before your time?
war: kundi ayaw liwat paguraura hin kamaraot o hin kalurongkay ano nga magpakamatay ka ha diri pa nimo panahon?

en: wisdom makes one wise person more powerful than ten rulers in a city.
war: dako an mahihimo han kinaadman para hin tawo kay han nahihimo hin napulo nga mga punoan para hin usa nga syudad.

en: indeed, there is no one on earth who is righteous, no one who does what is right and never sins.
war: waray tawo ha tuna nga dayuday nagbubuhat hin matadong ngan diri gud nagsasayop.

en: for you know in your heart that many times you yourself have cursed others.
war: ngan maaram ka ngahaw nga nakadamo ka na magtamay hin iba nga mga tawo.

en: all this i tested by wisdom and i said, “i am determined to be wise”— but this was beyond me.
war: ginamit ko an akon kinaadman hin pagsari hini ngatanan. nagtalinguha ako hin pagkamaaram, kundi makuri ko na maabot ini.

en: obey the kings command, i say, because you took an oath before God.
war: buhata an isinusugo han hadi, ngan ayaw pagdalidali hin pagsaad ha dyos.

en: since a kings word is supreme, who can say to him, “what are you doing?”
war: may gahom an hadi hin pagbuhat hin bisan ano, ngan waray nakakariwa ha iya.

en: for there is a proper time and procedure for every matter, though a person may be weighed down by misery.
war: may igo nga panahon ngan igo nga paagi hin pagbuhat han ngatanan, kundi gutiay gudla an aton hinbabaroan!

en: since no one knows the future, who can tell someone else what is to come?
war: waray ha aton maaram kon ano an mahinanabo, ngan waray tawo nga makakagsumat ha aton hini.

en: always be clothed in white, and always anoint your head with oil.
war: dayuday pagpakita nga malipayon ngan mahiyomhiyom ka.

en: i also saw under the sun this example of wisdom that greatly impressed me:
war: mayada pa ako hinkitan nga maupay nga susgaranan kon ginuunano naton hin pagtagad han kinaadman dinhe ha kalibutan.

en: the heart of the wise inclines to the right, but the heart of the fool to the left.
war: kinaiya hin tawo nga may kinaadman an pagbuhat han matadong, ngan kinaiya hin lurong an pagbuhat han kasaypanan.

en: there is an evil i have seen under the sun, the sort of error that arises from a ruler:
war: iini in karatan nga akon hinkitan ha kalibutankaratan nga binubuhat hin mga punoan.

en: fools are put in many high positions, while the rich occupy the low ones.
war: tinatagan hin higtaas nga mga katungdanan in lurong nga mga tawo, kundi hinngangalimtan an mga riko.

en: i have seen slaves on horseback, while princes go on foot like slaves.
war: hinkitan ko in dikabayo nga mga oripon, samtang naglalakat la nga baktas sugad hin mga oripon an mga dagko nga pagkatawo.

en: whoever digs a pit may fall into it; whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.
war: kon magluong ka, mahuhulog ka ngadto han luong. kon magruba ka, basi makalusot ka han pader, kakagton ka hin halas.

en: whoever quarries stones may be injured by them; whoever splits logs may be endangered by them.
war: kon magpusak ka hin mga bato, an bato an makakasamad ha imo. kon magtiak ka hin kahoy, masasamad ka hini.

en: if a snake bites before it is charmed, the charmer receives no fee.
war: kawang la an kamaaram mo hin paglumay hin halas kon mauna an halas hin pagkagat ha imo.

en: at the beginning their words are folly; at the end they are wicked madness—
war: intremes la anay an pagtikang, ngan ha katapusan, tinuyaw na nga mga pulong.

en: woe to the land whose king was a servant and whose princes feast in the morning.
war: masamok in nasod kon batanon pa an iya hadi, ngan magaga la hin kombite an iya mga pangulo.

en: through laziness, the rafters sag; because of idle hands, the house leaks.
war: kon uraura na hin kahubya in tawo hin pagayad han iya atop, magtuturo ini ngan marurumpag an iya balay.

en: ship your grain across the sea; after many days you may receive a return.

en: whoever watches the wind will not plant; whoever looks at the clouds will not reap.
war: kon humulat ka pa han igo nga hangin ngan han maupay nga panahon, diri ka gud makakagtanom, ngan waray nimo pagaanihon.

en: light is sweet, and it pleases the eyes to see the sun.
war: maupay an pagpahimulos han kapawa han adlaw.

en: and the dust returns to the ground it came from, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
war: mabalik ha tapotapo han tuna an aton mga lawas, ngan mabalik an aton espiritu ngadto sa dyos nga naghatag hini ha aton.

en: “meaningless! meaningless!” says the teacher. “everything is meaningless!”
war: waray la kapulsanan, waray la kapulsanan, nagsiring an magwarali. waray la kapulsanan ini ngatanan!

en: the teacher searched to find just the right words, and what he wrote was upright and true.
war: nagtalinguha an magwarali hin pamiling hin nakakaliaw nga mga pulong, kundi tangkod an mga pulong nga iya ginsurat.

en: for God will bring every deed into judgment, including every hidden thing, whether it is good or evil.
war: an dyos an maghuhukom han ngatanan nga aton ginbubuhat, magmaupay o magmaraot, bisan an mga butang nga ginbuhat hin hilom.

en: grace and peace to you from God our father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
war: tagan unta kamo han dyos nga aton amay ngan han Ginoo jesucristo hin grasya ngan kamurayaw.

en: he predestined us for adoption to sonship through Jesus Christ, in accordance with his pleasure and will—
war: an dyos daan naglarang nga pinaagi kan jesucristo, aangkonon kita nga iya mga anakamo ini an iya kalipay ngan an iya tuyo.

en: to the praise of his glorious grace, which he has freely given us in the one he loves.
war: pagdayawon ta an dyos tungod han iya mahimayaon nga grasya nga iginhatag ha aton pinaagi han iya hinigugma nga anak!

en: that he lavished on us. with all wisdom and understanding,
war: nga iya iginhatag ha aton hin waray sukol! ha bugos niya nga kinaadman ngan hibaro

en: he made known to us the mystery of his will according to his good pleasure, which he purposed in Christ,
war: ginbuhat han dyos an iya nahunahunaan, ngan iginpasabot niya ha aton an iya kaburuton hin paghingpit pinaagi kan Cristo.

en: in order that we, who were the first to put our hope in Christ, might be for the praise of his glory.
war: sanglit kita nga una maglaom kan Cristo magdayaw kita han himaya han dyos.

en: for this reason, ever since i heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all gods people,
war: tungod hini, tikang ako makabati han iyo pagtoo han Ginoo nga Jesus ngan han iyo paghigugma han ngatanan nga mga tawo han dyos,

en: i have not stopped giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers.
war: waray ako humunong hin pagpasalamat han dyos tungod ha iyo. hinnunumdoman ko kamo ha akon mga pagampo.

en: as for you, you were dead in your transgressions and sins,
war: hadto anay mga patay kamo ha espiritu tungod han iyo mga pagtalapas ngan mga sala.

en: but because of his great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
war: kundi labis an pagkalooy han dyos ha aton, ngan labi na an iya paghigugma ha aton,

en: and God raised us up with Christ and seated us with him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
war: ha aton pakigusa kan Cristo Jesus, ginbanhaw kita upod ha iya basi maghadi kita kaupod niya didto ha langit.

en: not by works, so that no one can boast.
war: waray gud niyo dinhe sadang ipanhambog, tungod nga diri ini bunga han iyo kalugaringon nga mga buhat.

en: but now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near by the blood of Christ.
war: kundi yana ha pakigusa kan Cristo Jesus, kamo nga hadto anay nahirayo han dyos, nahirani na pinaagi han kamatayon ni Cristo.

en: in him the whole building is joined together and rises to become a holy temple in the Lord.
war: amo hiya an nahawid han bugos nga balay, ngan nagpapadako ngadto hin usa nga templo nga baraan han Ginoo.

en: for this reason i, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles—
war: tungod hini, ako, hi Pablo nga binilanggo tungod kan Cristo Jesus para ha iyo nga mga hentil nagaampo ngadto han dyos.

en: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as i have already written briefly.
war: iginpadayag han dyos an iya tinago nga pagburotan ngan iginpahibaro niya ha akon. (nagsurat ako hin halipot hiunong hini,

en: in reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,
war: ngan kon iyo basahon an akon ginsurat, hibabaroan niyo an akon hinsabotan mahitungod han tinago mahitungod kan Cristo.)

en: according to his eternal purpose that he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
war: ginbuhat ini han dyos sumala han iya dayon nga panuyo, nga iya nahimo pinaagi kan Cristo Jesus nga aton Ginoo.

en: for this reason i kneel before the father,
war: sanglit tungod hini, naluhod ako ha atubangan han amay,

en: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
war: nga amo an nahatag han matuod nga ngaran ha tagsa nga panimalay ha langit ngan ha tuna.

en: to him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, for ever and ever! Amen.
war: dayawon ta hiya dida ha singbahan ug dida kan Cristo tubtob ha katubtoban. matuman kunta.

en: be completely humble and gentle; be patient, bearing with one another in love.
war: dayuday mapinaubsanon kamo, maaghop, ngan mailobon kamo. ipakita an iyo gugma pinaagi hin pakialayon han iba.

en: make every effort to keep the unity of the spirit through the bond of peace.
war: talinguhaa an pagpadayon han pagkaurosa nga iginhatag han espiritu, pinaagi han kamurayaw nga naggagapos ha iyo.

en: there is one body and one spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called;
war: mayada usa nga lawas ngan usa nga espiritu, sugad nga mayada usa nga paglaom nga tungod hini gintawag kamo han dyos.

en: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
war: mayada usa nga Ginoo, usa nga pagtoo, usa nga pagbunyag;

en: but to each one of us grace has been given as Christ apportioned it.
war: an kada usa ha aton tinagan hin upa, sumala han ginbahinbahin ni Cristo.

en: to equip his people for works of service, so that the body of Christ may be built up
war: ginbuhat niya ini hin pagandam han ngatanan nga magtinuohon para han cristiano nga pagalagad hin pagparigon han lawas ni Cristo.

en: that, however, is not the way of life you learned
war: diri amo ini an iyo hinbaroan hiunong kan Cristo!

en: to be made new in the attitude of your minds;
war: kinahanglan mabago hin hingpit an iyo mga kasingkasing ngan mga hunahuna.

en: “in your anger do not sin” :: do not let the sun go down while you are still angry,
war: kon masina kamo, ayaw itugot nga an kasina matinikangan han imo pakasala; ngan ayaw pagkinasina ha bugos nga adlaw.

en: and do not give the devil a foothold.
war: ayaw pagtagi hin higayon an yawa.

en: follow gods example, therefore, as dearly loved children
war: kay mga hinigugma man kamo nga mga anak han dyos, kinahanglan magtinguha kamo hin pagsubad ha iya.

en: therefore do not be partners with them.
war: sanglit likayi niyo an sugad nga mga tawo.

en: (for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness and truth)
war: kay an kapawa amo an nagaani han bunga han pagkamaupay, pagkamatadong, ngan kamatuoran.

en: and find out what pleases the Lord.
war: tinguhaa nga mahibaroan niyo an nakakalipay han Ginoo.

en: it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
war: makaarawod gudman bisan hin paghimangraw la mahitungod han mga butang nga binubuhat nira hin tago.)

en: but everything exposed by the light becomes visibleand everything that is illuminated becomes a light.
war: ngan kon madara na ha kapawan an ngatanan nga mga butang, dida hito madadayag na hin maupay an ira tinuod nga kinaiya;

en: making the most of every opportunity, because the days are evil.
war: pahimulosi niyo hin maupay an tagsa nga higayon nga iyo maaangkon, kay salaan ini nga mga adlaw.

en: therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the lords will is.
war: sanglit ayaw kamo pagpakalurong, kundi tinguhaa nga masabtan niyo an karuyag han Ginoo ipabuhat ha iyo.

en: do not get drunk on wine, which leads to debauchery. instead, be filled with the spirit,
war: ayaw gud kamo paghubog hin bino kay makakadaot ini ha iyo, kundi mapuno lugod kamo han espiritu.

en: submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
war: pagsinugtanay kamo tungod han iyo pagtahod kan Cristo.

en: wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands as you do to the Lord.
war: mga asawa, sugot kamo han iyo bana sugad han pagsugot niyo han Ginoo.

en: for we are members of his body.
war: kay mga kaapi kita han iya lawas.)

en: children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
war: mga anak, iyo ito cristianos nga katungdanan hin pagsugot han iyo mga kaganak, kay amo ini an angay buhaton.

en: “honor your father and motherwhich is the first commandment with a promise—
war: “pasidunggi an amay ug an iroy niyo.” amo ini an syahan nga sugo nga may igindugang nga saad:

en: “so that it may go well with you and that you may enjoy long life on the earth.”
war: “basi maghingaupay kamo, ngan mabuhi kamo hin maiha dinhe ha tuna.”

en: serve wholeheartedly, as if you were serving the Lord, not people,
war: sanglit buhata nga malipayon an iyo mga buruhaton ha ka oripon, nga daw an Ginoo an ginaalagad niyo, ngan diri la mga tawo.

en: finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.
war: ha kataposan padigona an iyo kusog pinaagi hin pakigusa han Ginoo ngan pinaagi han iya dako nga gahom.

en: put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devils schemes.
war: isulot niyo an bugos nga hinganiban nga ihinahatag han dyos ha iyo, basi makaato kamo supak han salaan nga mga limbong han yawa.

war: ngan an kaandam hin pagpasangyaw han maupay nga sumat han kalinaw sugad hin mga sandalyas han iyo mga tiil.

en: take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the spirit, which is the word of God.
war: ngan karawata niyo an katalwasan sugad hin helmet, ngan an pulong han dyos sugad hin espada nga ihinahatag ha iyo han espiritu.

en: peace to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith from God the father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
war: tagan unta han dyos nga amay ngan han Ginoo jesucristo hin kamurayaw ngan gugma, upod an pagtoo, an ngatanan nga kabugtoan.

en: grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
war: maada unta an grasya han dyos ha ngatanan nga nahigugma hin waray paglubad han aton Ginoo jesucristo.

war: para han mga judiyo may pagrayhak ngan kahimyangan, kalipayan ngan pagbati hin pagdaragan.

war: binmaton an babaye, “makakakaon kami han bunga hin bisan ano nga kahoy dinhe han tanaman,

en: “you will not certainly die,” the serpent said to the woman.
war: binmaton an halas, “buwa ito; diri kamo mapatay.

en: but the Lord God called to the man, “where are you?”

en: he answered, “i heard you in the garden, and i was afraid because i was naked; so i hid.”
war: binmaton hiya, “hinbatian ko ikaw dinhe han tanaman; nahadlok ako ngan tinmago ako ha imo, kay hubo ako.”

en: and he said, “who told you that you were naked? have you eaten from the tree that i commanded you not to eat from?”

en: it will produce thorns and thistles for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.

en: Adam named his wife Eve, because she would become the mother of all the living.
war: ginngaranan ni adan an iya asawa nga eva kay amo hiya an iroy han ngatanan nga mga tawo.

en: the Lord God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife and clothed them.

en: so the Lord God banished him from the garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.

en: in the course of time Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord ..
war: usa ka adlaw nagdara hi Cain hin mga abot han iya inani ngan iya iginhalad ini ngadto han Ginoo ..

en: but on Cain and his offering he did not look with favor. so Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.
war: kundi iginsikway niya hi Cain ngan an iya halad. napungot hin duro hi Cain ngan nagkuriot hiya hin kasina.

en: then the Lord said to Cain, “why are you angry? why is your face downcast?

en: Cain said to the Lord ,, “my punishment is more than i can bear.
war: ngan ginsiring ni Cain an Ginoo ,, “makuri ko ini maantos nga kastigo.

en: so Cain went out from the Lord ’s presence and lived in the land of nod, east of Eden.
